name: Informality rate (small firms, <=49 employees)
variable: Estimated from position in occupation x firm size

name: Informality rate (large firms, 50+ employees)
variable: Estimated from position in occupation x firm size

name: Small firms employment share (formal sector)
variable: Share of formal employment in firms with <=49 employees
notes: RAIS-based, formal employment only (not PNAD all-workers)

name: Large firms employment share (formal sector)
variable: Share of formal employment in firms with 50+ employees

name: Formal cost wedge (small firms)
variable: Effective marginal cost of formalization for small firms
notes: Calibrated to reproduce INF_SMALL via wedge bisection

name: Formal cost wedge (large firms)
variable: Effective marginal cost of formalization for large firms
notes: Calibrated to reproduce INF_LARGE via wedge bisection

name: Hours bin weight: <=36h workers
variable: Share of formal workers assigned to 36h bin
notes: Mapped from DIEESE <=39h category; mapping documented in paper/tex/online_appendix.tex

name: Hours bin weight: 40h workers
variable: Share of formal workers assigned to 40h bin
notes: Mapped from DIEESE 40h category; mapping documented in paper/tex/online_appendix.tex

name: Hours bin weight: >=41h workers
variable: Share of formal workers assigned to 44h bin
notes: Mapped from DIEESE >=41h category; mapping documented in paper/tex/online_appendix.tex

name: Relative efficiency of informal labor
notes: Theoretically consistent with CES marginal-product identification under competitive wage-taking

name: Hours-output elasticity at h_ref
variable: Elasticity of output w.r.t. hours at reference formal hours

name: Baseline weekly hours cap (formal)
variable: Legal maximum weekly hours in Brazil (pre-reform)

name: Peak-efficiency hours
variable: Hours at which per-hour efficiency is maximized
notes: Modeling choice informed by long-hour productivity evidence; not directly estimated for Brazil

name: Informal sector hours
variable: Hours worked by informal workers (not subject to cap)
notes: Assumption: informals work the pre-reform maximum
